text:
Nora (Design): quick thread on the create-pool form: when many errors appear the page gets "loud". we need a calm-first pattern that still helps users fix blockers fast.
Eli (Eng): idea: always show a single top summary with counts + show the first 2 inline errors per section. provide a 'Show all errors' expandable panel. keeps vertical rhythm stable. :brain:
Jia L: a11y: top summary should use `role=alert` (or status on non-blocking) so SRs are informed. when the panel opens, move focus into it. ensure collapsed helpers are keyboard accessible.
Marco (PM): copy note: summary text options: "3 required fields missing  View" or shorter "3 errors  View details". shorter probably better for repeat users.
Nora (Design): required indicator: per-field `*` + sr-only "required" is our baseline. in dense tables use header-level `*` with tooltip "Required column" so cells stay clean.
Eli (Eng): destructive flows inside form (remove mapping) -> modal + undo toast. typed-confirm for account/model deletes only. modal copy must be explicit: e.g., "Remove mapping from pool". toast: "Mapping removed  Undo" (8s).
Jia L: accessibility nit: modals must trap focus, announce heading/body; primary action should be labelled fully and come after the body in tab order so SR users hear consequences first. undo toasts should be keyboard-focusable and have `role=alert`.
Nora (Design): visual tweak: collapse helper text by default, show a chevron to expand. on validation jump to a field, auto-expand its helper and focus input. preserve expansion state across validation cycles.
Eli (Eng): implementation note: keep undo client-first with server TTL so replays possible. also severity buckets: error/warning/info badges help triage.
Marco (PM): action items: Nora to mock top-summary + panel variant and collapsed-helpers variant, include copy snippets and a11y checklist. will review tomorrow.
